metadata.description: Welcome to Main Bhi Bharat! Today, we have a very special live chat session with a tribal couple from the Baiga tribe of Madhya Pradesh. They have travelled all the way to Delhi to meet us, and during their stay, we have come to understand their deep awareness of the challenges their tribe faces. Let's dive into this inspiring conversation and learn more about their experiences and aspirations.
